svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
AMSCO under SHADOW: cells of one and two letters in turn, each row starting with the other size; columns read in the key's order
the first six rows of cells (place numbers)
column 3 (A) is read first: its cells hold places 4, 13-14, 22 ...
place 22 is the third cell's only letter: it comes out 4th, on the copper's R
where each known letter lands, and the carved letter there
OUT: NO READING; ONE EXCESS, AT PERIOD 23, WITHIN CHANCE
